effect_description_eng:
One of your [Gammamon] that has a digivolution card with [Gammamon] in its name may digivolve into this card in your hand for a digivolution cost of 3, ignoring digivolution requirements.
[All Turns] This Digimon gains all effects of cards with [Gammamon] in their names in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
